gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Noto Sans Limbu has tall-bodied small letters and curves that gape open, a plain sans with an easygoing manner. Junegull is best at being a bold retro headline with pinched curves, and the body is best at staying open.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Noto Sans Lydian keeps its capitals barely taller than its lowercase, with openings as wide as a sprung paper clip, which gives Junegull a mild partner. Text flows smoothly.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-mahajan: Noto Sans Mahajani stands its lowercase tall against the capitals, with a wide funnel-shaped throat in the e. Junegull is built like bent tubing, and Noto Sans Mahajani is the open counterpart, so closed letters meet open ones.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-malayal: Stout and friendly up top. Junegull draws every diagonal as stout as every upright, and Noto Sans Malayalam is a plain sans whose dominant middle zone gives long lines a dense, generous texture, with an s that opens between its bends.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-mandaic: Noto Sans Mandaic lets its lowercase rise close to the capitals, with curvy letters that feel unclamped under Junegull's plain, unshaded line. Its strongest quality is the contrast of closed against loose.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-marchen: Retro and chunky, then wide open. Junegull holds a plain, unshaded line that never swells, while Noto Sans Marchen is a sans-serif with proud, almost capital-sized small letters and curves ending in clear daylight.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-mayan-n: Noto Sans Mayan Numerals has tall-bodied small letters and a gaping c. Under Junegull's closed, pinched shapes, a longer stretch of text would feel open and breezy, with the body offering relief after the heading's tight curves.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-medefai: Junegull draws every letter with one constant line width. Noto Sans Medefaidrin lifts its lowercase high and leaves no ink pooling where curves turn in, so the two feel like a retro friend beside a crisp, modern one.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-meetei-: Noto Sans Meetei Mayek reads large-eyed and open. Its strongest quality is the rounds that gap like a cracked bangle, which sit against Junegull's technical-pen line weight and pinched, closed shapes.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-mende-k: Junegull draws pencil-like lines that never thicken or thin. It is best at a tight, retro punch, while Noto Sans Mende Kikakui is best at letting daylight through every curved opening beneath tall lowercase.
